name: Iori Junpei
source:
Junpei is a former member of SEES, currently a reserve member of Shadow Operatives and the coach of the little league (as in baseball). Junpei is portrayed as somewhat goofy, perverted, kind, caring, upbeat, and sometimes serious in missions and other events. When spoken to, he often cracks jokes and calls people "dude". He is in love with Chidori very much, shown in how he daydreams about proposing to her.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Junpei_Iori]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

He wields the [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Trismegistus]Trismegistus[/url] persona, a famous alchemist, astrologist and magician.
